title: Ulla, Son of Rav Ilai
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: He was Rav Yosef’s colleague. In [Shevuot 30a](https://www.sefaria.org/Shevuot.30a.14), Ulla has a case before Rav Nachman, and Rav Yosef sends word: “Ulla is our colleague, a peer in Torah.”[^1] In [Bava Kamma 7a](https://www.sefaria.org/Bava_Kamma.7a.13-14), Abaye raises a difficulty against him.

He is mentioned in halakhic passages: [Shabbat 129a](https://www.sefaria.org/Shabbat.129a.7), [Beitzah 22a](https://www.sefaria.org/Beitzah.22a.15), [Bava Kamma 7a](https://www.sefaria.org/Bava_Kamma.7a.13), [Zevachim 11b](https://www.sefaria.org/Zevachim.11b.24).

notes.text: [Shevuot 30a:14](https://www.sefaria.org/Shevuot.30a.14) and [Seder HaDorot 2844](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=2844&lang=en) both have “a peer in Torah and mitzvot.” Hyman quotes the shorter wording. In the full exchange, Rav Nachman understands Rav Yosef’s message as asking him to hear Ulla’s case first.
